$comment: An entry of the fake EDGAR's request log: one request its server received. spec/fake-edgar.md governs it (section 6); changing it changes that spec.
title: Request

headers.$comment: Each header by its name in lower case: a token of RFC 9110, without upper-case letters.

url.$comment: A stored URL, on one of the SEC's hosts (FETCH-1).

timestamp.$comment: A time in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds and Z (spec/snapshots.md, section 2). The pattern holds each part to its range, leaving out a leap second, which the fake EDGAR's clock doesn't give; the format, which a validator asserts, holds each day to its month.
